done_when: forge.toml limits the routes interface pattern to API code (apps/api/**/routes/**) and keeps every other interface pattern unchanged

findings.body: The branch changes the interface glob but adds no test. This fix needs a repository-suite test that invokes Forge’s command and verifies that a web screen under apps/web/src/routes is excluded while an API route under apps/api is included. Such a test would fail with the previous broad glob; none appears in the supplied branch diff.
findings.title: Not done: Forge command test for the routes interface rule

why: Forge's interface rule **/routes/** blocks small web-screen fixes because the web app keeps its screens in apps/web/src/routes
